title: Elevate UI Typography: Unlock OpenType Magic with CSS 'font-feature-settings'
tweet: Beyond basics! Master CSS 'font-feature-settings' to unlock advanced OpenType features like ligatures & stylistic sets. Elevate UI readability & aesthetic appeal with powerful web font capabilities. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UX
tip: Leverage the 'font-feature-settings' CSS property to activate specific OpenType features embedded within your web fonts. This allows you to enable stylistic enhancements like discretionary ligatures, old-style figures, small caps, or specific stylistic sets, which significantly improve the visual quality and readability of your text. For instance, enabling 'dlig' (discretionary ligatures) can refine character connections for a more polished look, while 'salt' (stylistic alternates) can offer variant glyphs to differentiate your UI. Always test with your chosen font as feature support varies.
